reply_text:
I've saved Ilse's note to memory: the signed order form at Quarrendon Freight Lines is due 7 October. I also replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to say it's recorded.

In that reply I mentioned that 7 October 2026 had already passed when they posted on 16 October. They may mean 7 October 2027, so the memory says the year isn't confirmed. They asked for no action, so I did nothing else.

This is a separate account from the Tamsin Greywater deadline already in memory, so I added it as its own entry rather than changing that one.
